_about: Probe data of the filter-list safety net (Task 29). must_resolve: names the house really depends on, built from AdGuard's 30-day top-queried list (connectivity checks of Android/Apple/Windows/Firefox/MIUI, the mesh router's cloud, cameras, NTP, Google/Facebook sign-in) plus example.org (a harmless CANARY: the failing-list proof blocks only this name, so a deliberate failure can never hurt the house) plus the infrastructure this server needs (Tailscale control plane, Telegram API, DoH upstreams, Docker/GHCR/GitHub, Debian mirrors, Cloudflare) and the Czech banks and O2. Only names that resolve BEFORE a change are required to resolve AFTER it, so a name that was already blocked never fails a change by itself. The live top-queried names (minus anything already blocked and the harness test names) are added at probe time. sentinels: names that must stay blocked - only those blocked by some list OTHER than the one being removed or disabled count.
